## Project Overview

I want to find out how many MLB ballparks would turn the same hit into a home run based on its exit velocity, launch angle, and direction. I will compare left field, center field, and right field to see how different stadium dimensions affect the outcome.

### Intended Audience

The main audience is people who watch and enjoy Major League Baseball. However, this project could also interest anyone who enjoys sports, coding, or statistics and wants to learn how data can explain what happens in baseball.

### Why This Topic Matters

This topic interests me because I play baseball and enjoy watching MLB. I want to explore how different ballpark dimensions affect home runs and why the same hit might be a home run in one stadium but stay in play in another. I also think it would be interesting to combine my passion for baseball with coding and data analysis to discover patterns across all MLB ballparks.

## Outfield Depth & Home Run Thresholds

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Load Statcast batted ball dataset (7,100+ balls in play)
batted <- read_csv("data/batted_balls.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(!is.na(launch_speed), !is.na(launch_angle), !is.na(hc_x), !is.na(hc_y), !is.na(hit_distance_sc)) |>
  mutate(
    # Spray angle in degrees (negative = left, positive = right)
    spray_angle = atan((hc_x - 125.42) / (198.27 - hc_y)) * 180 / pi,
    field_direction = case_when(
      spray_angle < -15 ~ "Left Field (Min HR: 343 ft)",
      spray_angle > 15 ~ "Right Field (Min HR: 318 ft)",
      TRUE ~ "Center Field (Min HR: 378 ft)"
    ),
    field_direction = factor(field_direction, levels = c(
      "Left Field (Min HR: 343 ft)",
      "Center Field (Min HR: 378 ft)",
      "Right Field (Min HR: 318 ft)"
    )),
    outcome = if_else(events == "home_run", "Home Run", "In Play / Out")
  )

# Plot Exit Velocity vs Launch Angle across field directions
ggplot(batted, aes(x = launch_speed, y = launch_angle)) +
  geom_point(data = filter(batted, outcome == "In Play / Out"), 
             color = "#8da0cb", alpha = 0.25, size = 1.3) +
  geom_point(data = filter(batted, outcome == "Home Run"), 
             aes(size = hit_distance_sc), color = "#d95f02", alpha = 0.85) +
  facet_wrap(~ field_direction) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 4.5), name = "Distance (ft)") +
  labs(
    title = "MLB Home Runs: Impact of Exit Velocity, Launch Angle & Ballpark Depth",
    subtitle = "Center field requires higher exit velocity (min 99 mph) and greater distance (378+ ft) to clear the fence",
    x = "Exit Velocity (mph)",
    y = "Launch Angle (degrees)",
    caption = "Data: 7,100+ Statcast batted balls (June 2024) | Baseball Savant"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
  )
```
